_comment: VISIBLE section title MUST stay NEUTRAL ('Unsere Partner'). Do NOT reveal these are founding/honor sponsors anywhere user-facing. 10 entries. Per sponsor: brand, logo (grey-box placeholder SVG; degrades to text box on 404), products (Produktpalette, ein Satz), philosophy (richtext: a <strong> tag is allowed), click_out (label + url, rendered rel='sponsored nofollow noopener' target=_blank). `active:false` => skip in render. ALLES PLATZHALTER — vom Partner-Onboarding befüllen.
